article_notes: Descriptive Ukrainian clinic series of 36 dogs with babesiosis (B. canis named in the introduction, smear diagnosis). Only frequencies of clinical signs and whole-group mean laboratory values are reported; no grouping by severity or outcome and no statistical comparison. A single qualitative remark that eosinophilia occurs in a severe course has no numbers or group sizes. Nothing extractable against severity. English text is an LLM translation from Ukrainian.

not_extracted.what: Statement that eosinophilia develops in a severe course (and leucopenia in a chronic course)
not_extracted.note: Qualitative remark only; no severity groups, counts or values.
